title: Your Cold Email Acquisition Channel - Setup to Scale

sections.label: 1 - INFRASTRUCTURE THAT PROTECTS YOUR MAIN DOMAIN
sections.note: Everything sends from lookalike domains on your card. 30 a day per mailbox, 3 mailboxes per domain, warmed before a single email goes out.

sections.label: 2 - TWO LISTS, BOTH CLEANED BEFORE THEY LOAD
sections.note: Distressed-owner data and agent data come from different places and get different treatment. Nothing loads until it is verified.

sections.label: 3 - COPY THAT READS LIKE A PERSON WROTE IT
sections.note: Plain text, short, one ask. Sellers and agents get their own sequences with a first line pulled from the record.

sections.label: 4 - TWO WEEKS AT LOW VOLUME BEFORE WE SCALE
sections.note: Bounce, reply, positive reply and spam complaints decide what scales. Losers get cut, winners get more inboxes.

sections.label: 5 - SCALE IT, THEN YOUR TEAM RUNS IT
sections.note: More inboxes and domains, the automation engine doing the daily grind, a scorecard your team reads, and a runbook so it does not depend on me.
